column1: # The hand-checked Hebrew-to-Greek pairs of the 2026-10-19 LXX bridge
# appendix): 63 common equivalences and 36 mid- and low-frequency ones, each
# checked against STEPBible's TBESH and TBESG glosses. A Greek lemma listed is
# an ACCEPTABLE rendering of the Hebrew one; most rows have one.

# rows, and the opt-in test in scripture_import/bridge.rs holds them at the
# measurement's 0.98 and 1.00. A sanity check, not a gold set C.
